systems.name: 3.1 Pattern Library
systems.notes: Create predefined patterns (BLOCK, GLIDER, LWSS, etc.) as coordinate arrays.
tasks: Define BLOCK, GLIDER, LWSS, PULSAR, etc. as offsets from origin
Write function to place a pattern on gridCurrent

systems.name: 3.2 Spawn with Fog Penalty
systems.notes: Check footprint against fog; apply 50% fail chance if any cell is under fog.
tasks: When spawning, check each pattern cell's fog mask for the agent
If any cell has mask=0, roll 50% chance to cancel entire spawn
On success, write pattern to gridCurrent (overwrite existing cells)

systems.name: 3.3 Instant Conflict Resolution
systems.notes: When a spawn writes over opponent cells, both cells annihilate immediately.
tasks: Before writing a pattern cell, check current occupant
If opponent color, set cell to empty (annihilate both)
Handle chain reactions (if a spawn triggers further annihilation, no recursive loop needed)
